description: Renders up to 50 variants. With a seed the output is deterministic (variant i uses seed "<seed>#<i>"); without one it is random. The engine is lenient: structural mistakes never throw, they surface in the output — run validate_spintax first.

locale.description: Locale for {plural …} arity, e.g. "en" (2-form) or "ru" (3-form: ru/uk/be/sr/hr/bs). Omit for the 2-form default.

seed.description: Deterministic RNG seed; omit for random output.

template.description: Spintax template source. #include is disabled on this server.

name: render_spintax
title: Render spintax variants
